name: Meridian Calendar Receptionist — Verified Adapter Bridge

parameters.content:
## Meridian signed calendar bridge — inactive until configured
1. Webhook Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer [the per-deployment calendar connector secret].
2. Configure Adapter URL: set the approved HTTPS calendar adapter endpoint. The blank default fails closed.
3. HTTP Request Header Auth credential: select the adapter credential agreed with its owner. To use Meridian HMAC/bearer contract unchanged, use the same connector secret.
4. Calendar actions and business rules are performed by the verified adapter, not this bridge. Attach its real calendar OAuth/account separately.
5. Prove availability → book → reschedule → cancel, duplicate request handling, unavailable-slot rejection and failure behavior before marking the deployment verified.
6. Activate; use the production webhook URL. No credentials or client records are shipped in this template.

meta.description: Authenticated validation and confirmation bridge. Requires a real downstream calendar adapter. No direct Google Calendar connection is included.
